dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for the advice. What happened to your eyes?

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: Hmph, this was the work of a hairless heathen. He left me with this mark, but I know he's somewhere on the island... and I'll be damned if I don't "thank" him for it later.

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: After hearing my story, you're sure to want to take revenge on my behalf. But that's quite alright — though I should thank you for your kindness!

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: Dear friend, in a summer this beautiful, nobody should be feeling sad!

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: Please enjoy the welcome juice I've prepared for each and every guest, then enjoy your relaxing vacation.

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: You'll find your beverages on that shelf over there.

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: My dear friend, now that you've had my welcome juice, let me give you a word of advice.

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: If you're just an ordinary visitor enjoying your vacation, then steer clear of the northernmost part of Tete Isle. There's nothing over there that will help you relax.

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: Hey there, friend! Welcome to Paititi — and Tete Isle — the place of your dreams!

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: Ahead, you'll find two of our bars, Me & Dew and The Dewdrop. I'm Tecuhtli, and it's my job to welcome guests!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: You haven't asked me about my eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Haven't we met before?

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: My friend, this is fate's mark upon the extraordinary — our first meeting feels like a reunion across lifetimes.

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: Seeing this wolfish eye patch of mine, you've surely realized I'm pretty extraordinary, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: Oh? You're asking about my eyes? Hehe, well, there are three things every man has to cultivate in his life.

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: First! A weathered body must bear at least one scar. Otherwise, there's no way to tell what trials and tribulations a man has faced, and he would appear to lack substance.

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: Second! Scars must be covered with clothes or accessories, but only partially... Otherwise, no one would see that this man is special.

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: And third...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a second. I never even asked about your eyes...

dialogues.speaker: Tecuhtli
dialogues.text: Exactly! If others don't notice how special he is, the man must MAKE them notice by bringing it up!
